dct_description_sm: Used within the Travellers Road Information Portal Interactive Map to convey transportation related information in both official languages. This information includes a list of locations of carpool parking lots near dozens of highway interchanges throughout Ontario. This data is best viewed using Google Earth or similar Keyhole Markup Language (KML) compatible software.
